_comment: Copy this file to manifest.json next to your data and fill it in.
The manifest is not read by the code. It exists so that anyone looking at
a checkpoint can find out what it was trained on, from where, and under
what terms -- and so that a reviewer can check the claim rather than trust it.
Delete every key you cannot actually fill in. An honest gap beats a filled-in guess.
name: aster-demo-chat
description: 332 short question/answer pairs written by hand for the Aster teaching demo, covering what the model is, what it cannot do, and refusals for medical, legal, financial, hiring and emergency topics.

provenance.author: the Aster project
provenance.method: written by hand for this repository
provenance.notes: No third-party corpus, no copyrighted source text, and no real person's identifying detail was used at any point.

license.notes: Applies only to the files in this directory. It says nothing about data you add later.

known_limitations: Far too small for the model to learn general knowledge.
Validation questions are unseen but topically adjacent, so held-out loss overstates real generalisation.
Answers share a single narrow voice, which flatters the loss relative to open-ended chat.
